/**
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Hand-written test fixture modeled on Sanity TypeGen output (`sanity typegen generate`):
 * schema types, then one result type per query, then the global query registry.
 * ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 */

export declare const internalGroqTypeReferenceTo: unique symbol;

// Source: schema.json
export type SanityImageAssetReference = {
  _ref: string;
  _type: "reference";
  _weak?: boolean;
  [internalGroqTypeReferenceTo]?: "sanity.imageAsset";
};

export type SanityImageCrop = {
  _type: "sanity.imageCrop";
  top?: number;
  bottom?: number;
  left?: number;
  right?: number;
};

export type SanityImageHotspot = {
  _type: "sanity.imageHotspot";
  x?: number;
  y?: number;
  height?: number;
  width?: number;
};

// A schema type whose generated name looks like an alias name.
export type SpanShape = {
  _type: "spanShape";
  corners?: number;
};

export type Hero = {
  _type: "hero";
  title?: string;
  body?: Array<{
    children?: Array<{
      marks?: Array<string>;
      text?: string;
      _type: "span";
      _key: string;
    }>;
    style?: "normal" | "h2" | "h3";
    markDefs?: Array<{
      href?: string;
      _type: "link";
      _key: string;
    }>;
    _type: "block";
    _key: string;
  }>;
  image?: {
    asset?: SanityImageAssetReference;
    media?: unknown; // Unable to locate the referenced type "hero.image.media" in schema
    hotspot?: SanityImageHotspot;
    crop?: SanityImageCrop;
    _type: "image";
  };
};

export type Cta = {
  _type: "cta";
  label?: string;
  body?: Array<{
    children?: Array<{
      marks?: Array<string>;
      text?: string;
      _type: "span";
      _key: string;
    }>;
    style?: "normal" | "h2" | "h3";
    markDefs?: Array<{
      href?: string;
      _type: "link";
      _key: string;
    }>;
    _type: "block";
    _key: string;
  }>;
  image?: {
    asset?: SanityImageAssetReference;
    media?: unknown; // Unable to locate the referenced type "cta.image.media" in schema
    hotspot?: SanityImageHotspot;
    crop?: SanityImageCrop;
    _type: "image";
  };
};

export type PageBuilder = Array<
  | ({
      _key: string;
    } & Hero)
  | ({
      _key: string;
    } & Cta)
>;

export type Page = {
  _id: string;
  _type: "page";
  title?: string;
  slug?: string;
  pageBuilder?: PageBuilder;
};

export type AllSanitySchemaTypes =
  | SanityImageAssetReference
  | SanityImageCrop
  | SanityImageHotspot
  | SpanShape
  | Hero
  | Cta
  | PageBuilder
  | Page;

// Source: queries.ts
// Variable: pageQuery
// Query: *[_type == "page" && slug.current == $slug][0]{ _id, title, "seo-title": seoTitle, image{ "id": asset._ref, alt, crop }, ... }
export type PageQueryResult = {
  _id: string;
  title: string | null;
  "seo-title": string | null;
  image: {
    id: string | null;
    alt: string | null;
    crop: {
      _type: "sanity.imageCrop";
      top?: number;
      bottom?: number;
      left?: number;
      right?: number;
    } | null;
  } | null;
  ogImage:
    | {
        id: string | null;
        alt: string | null;
        crop: {
          _type: "sanity.imageCrop";
          top?: number;
          bottom?: number;
          left?: number;
          right?: number;
        } | null;
      }
    | null;
  pageBuilder: Array<
    | {
        _key: string;
        _type: "hero";
        title?: string;
        body: Array<{
          children?: Array<{
            marks?: Array<string>;
            text?: string;
            _type: "span";
            _key: string;
          }>;
          style?: "h2" | "h3" | "normal";
          markDefs: Array<{
            href?: string;
            _type: "link";
            _key: string;
            openInNewTab: boolean | null;
          }> | null;
          _type: "block";
          _key: string;
        }> | null;
        image: {
          id: string | null;
          alt: string | null;
          crop: {
            _type: "sanity.imageCrop";
            top?: number;
            bottom?: number;
            left?: number;
            right?: number;
          } | null;
        } | null;
      }
    | {
        _key: string;
        _type: "cta";
        label: "Read \"more\" { now }" | 'it\'s } here' | null;
        body: Array<{
          children?: Array<{
            marks?: Array<string>;
            text?: string;
            _type: "span";
            _key: string;
          }>;
          style?: "h2" | "h3" | "normal";
          markDefs: Array<{
            href?: string;
            _type: "link";
            _key: string;
            openInNewTab: boolean | null;
          }> | null;
          _type: "block";
          _key: string;
        }> | null;
      }
  > | null;
} | null;

// Source: queries.ts
// Variable: pagesQuery
// Query: *[_type == "page"]{ _id, title, thumbnail{ "id": asset._ref, alt, crop }, "cards": [[...]], order }
export type PagesQueryResult = Array<{
  _id: string;
  title: string | null;
  thumbnail: {
    'id': string | null;
    "alt": string | null;
    crop: {
      _type: "sanity.imageCrop";
      top?: number;
      bottom?: number;
      left?: number;
      right?: number;
    } | null;
  } | null;
  cards: Array<
    Array<{
      title: string | null;
      summary: string | null;
      image: {
        id: string | null;
        alt: string | null;
        crop: {
          _type: "sanity.imageCrop";
          top?: number;
          bottom?: number;
          left?: number;
          right?: number;
        } | null;
      } | null;
    }>
  >;
  order: {
    title: string | null;
    summary: string | null;
    position: number;
    pinned: boolean;
  };
  sameOrderAgain: {
    title: string | null;
    summary: string | null;
    position: number;
    pinned: boolean;
  };
  otherOrder: {
    summary: string | null;
    title: string | null;
    position: number;
    pinned: boolean;
  };
}>;

// Source: queries.ts
// Variable: settingsQuery
// Query: *[_type == "settings"][0]{ logo{ "id": asset._ref, alt, crop }, footerLogo{ ... }, ... }
export type SettingsQueryResult = {
  logo: {
    id: string | null; /* the logo } */
    alt: string | null; // a { comment
    crop: {
      _type: "sanity.imageCrop";
      top?: number;
      bottom?: number;
      left?: number;
      right?: number;
    } | null;
  } | null;
  footerLogo: {
    readonly id: string | null;
    alt: string | null;
    crop: {
      _type: "sanity.imageCrop";
      top?: number;
      bottom?: number;
      left?: number;
      right?: number;
    } | null;
  } | null;
  footer: {
    title: string | null;
    summary: string | null;
    position: number;
    pinned: boolean;
  } | null;
  links: Array<{
    href?: string;
    _type: "link";
    _key: string;
    openInNewTab: boolean | null;
  }>;
} | null;

// Query TypeMap
declare global {
  interface SanityQueries {
    '*[_type == "page" && slug.current == $slug][0]{ _id, title, "seo-title": seoTitle, image{ "id": asset._ref, alt, crop }, ... }': PageQueryResult;
    '*[_type == "page"]{ _id, title, thumbnail{ "id": asset._ref, alt, crop }, "cards": [[...]], order }': PagesQueryResult;
    '*[_type == "settings"][0]{ logo{ "id": asset._ref, alt, crop }, footerLogo{ ... }, ... }': SettingsQueryResult;
  }
}
// Lets @sanity/client releases that predate the global registry read it too
declare module "@sanity/client" {
  interface SanityQueries extends globalThis.SanityQueries {}
}
